versions.text: Criterion: Verify that the parachute landing system installation prevents damage or detrimental effects to system components from environmental conditions. Standard: The parachute storage compartment and component design protect the parachute system in the packed condition from adverse internal and external environmental conditions (e.g., flight loads, electromagnetic interference, rain, humidity, and snow). For parachute landing system components located near the propulsion system, adequate cooling, shielding, and material selection are provided to prevent degradation of the parachute landing system which could impair or jeopardize a successful landing. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include tests and demonstrations. Laboratory testing and demonstrations verify the absence of adverse effects due to operating environments. References: JSSG-2010: 3.12.1.2 Stowed interface

Standard: Parachute landing system storage compartment and component design should protect packed parachute system from adverse internal and external environmental conditions (e.g., flight loads, EMI, rain, humidity, and snow). For parachute landing system components located near the propulsion system, cooling, shielding, and material selection prevents degradation of the parachute landing system that could prevent successful landing. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review material data sheets to verify material selection can function in the design environmental conditions. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct thermal analysis to verify parachute landing system can function and is not damaged in its installed environment. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing to verify the absence of adverse effects (e.g., failure to deploy and material degradation) due to the operating environment.
    (2) Ground test: Conduct ground test to verify the absence of adverse effects due to the operating environment. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
    (3) Flight test: Conduct flight test to verify the absence of adverse effects due to the operating environment.
